params._enclaveCodeHash: MRENCLAVE of the Ritual inference container                               that will decrypt & judge answers. This                               guarantees the LLM prompt + model are                               cryptographically fixed.
params._verifier: Address of Ritual's on-chain attestation                               verifier contract.

params.winnerIndex: Index into participants array of the winner.

submitEncryptedAnswer(uint256,bytes).details: The encrypted blob is stored on-chain as calldata. For large          submissions (>~100KB), store the ciphertext on IPFS/Arweave          and submit only the content-hash here.

params.encryptedAnswer: The answer encrypted with Ritual's TEE public key.

params.attestation: TEE attestation proof (e.g., ECDSA sig from enclave                       over the hash of bountyId + rankedAddrs + scores).

createBounty(uint256,bytes32,address).notice: Create a bounty pinned to a specific TEE enclave measurement.

finalizeWinner(uint256,uint256).notice: Locks in the winner. Only callable by the bounty creator.

submitEncryptedAnswer(uint256,bytes).notice: Submit an encrypted answer. The caller encrypts their plaintext          answer client-side using Ritual's public key so that ONLY the          pinned TEE enclave can decrypt it.

submitJudgingResult(uint256,address[],ui.notice: Called by Ritual's TEE node AFTER the submission deadline.          The TEE node:            1. Reads all encrypted submissions from chain.            2. Decrypts them inside the enclave.            3. Runs a single batch LLM call to score all answers.            4. Calls this function with scores + TEE attestation.          The contract verifies the attestation against the pinned          enclaveCodeHash before accepting the scores.
